breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the flexural second moment with a polar moment in the curvature relation, even though beam bending curvature is governed by M/(E I).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that using the polar second moment of area (J) is incorrect for beam bending. It correctly used the flexural second moment of area (I) in the curvature relation κ = M/(EI), which matches the ground truth. The agent also provided a clear explanation of why the user's instruction was incorrect and why 'I' is the appropriate variable.
